purpose: Machine-readable rule-specification foundation for CiteJury. Rules here describe support status and provenance; they do not automatically mean full production accuracy.

rules.label: Readable Indian judgment citation helper
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
limitations: Current output is a practical readable helper, not a fully verified Indian court citation standard.
Reporter-specific Indian rules require EP-033 overhaul before high-confidence claims.

rules.label: SCC-style judgment helper
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
limitations: SCC is a reporter-style helper only in this EP.
Do not treat generated output as verified SCC editorial style until EP-033 adds rule-level authority and tests.

rules.label: AIR-style judgment helper
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
limitations: AIR output remains provisional until reporter-specific examples and edge cases are verified in EP-033.

rules.label: OSCOLA-like judgment helper
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
limitations: Existing output is OSCOLA-like, not a complete OSCOLA implementation.
EP-034 should implement neutral citation, law report priority, legislation, secondary sources, and bibliography behavior with tests.

rules.label: Readable legislation citation helper
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
limitations: Provision labels, chapter numbers, enactment numbers, jurisdiction, and amendments require future rule expansion.
